name: c-thru
description: Router/proxy that lets Claude Code talk to alternative model providers (Ollama, OpenRouter, Bedrock, Vertex, Gemini, LiteLLM) without changing the vendor CLI. Plugin: proxy hooks, /c-thru:c-thru-status via local proxy API. Full agentic /cplan waves need the CLI fleet from this repo. Optional planning-suite for /schedule-plan-tasks.
